thread:
kevin: Hey — quick check. Vendor portal shows our west-eu A100 pool quota at 512 but our billing/metrics show ~420 active slots. Did anyone open a batch reservation that I'm missing? :thinking:

maria: not from infra side. I saw a procurement PR but it was for 'standby lanes', not reserve. link to PR: https://git.internal/pr/4821

alex: I can run a portal API check. Give me 30s.

alex: (output) vendor-api GET /accounts/redwood/pools/west-eu -> {
  "total_quota": 512,
  "allocated": 512,
  "claimed": 420,
  "holds": ["po-9981"]
}

kevin: interesting — holds: po-9981. procurement-bot, do you have context on po-9981?

procurement-bot: PO-9981 created 2026-03-18 by jia for "eviction-safe standby". Status: pending-invoice. Contact: jia@redwood.ai

jia: yes that was the standby lane for a demo next week. I thought it was soft-hold but vendor marked it as allocated on their side when I uploaded the invoice draft. My bad, I can ask them to flip to soft-hold.

kevin: If vendor marks as allocated we get charged when invoice clears. We should avoid hard-allocation until demo day. Can you request soft-hold and confirm ETA? :pray:

jia: pinged vendor support, they replied: "can flip to soft-hold within 1h if PO state updated to 'provisional'". Doing that now.

maria: Also seeing a firmware/ASIC mismatch warning in telemetry for a subset of those racks — may explain the claimed vs active difference. ops-oncall, any ongoing maintenance?

ops-oncall: We're running a rolling firmware loopback on rack nodes 5-9 in west-eu starting 04:00 UTC for stability patch (expected 2h). Impact: nodes marked unavailable in vendor portal during loopback.

kevin: OK that explains the ~92 slots gap (512 - 420). Good catch. Two action items: (1) jia -> vendor flip PO to provisional/soft-hold, confirm before EOD; (2) ops -> post when firmware loopback completes so we can reconcile with portal.

jia: vendor confirmed PO state updated to provisional. They will re-run allocation sweep in 20m.

ops-oncall: loopback finished on 04:58 UTC, nodes back to available. I'm running reconciler now.

alex: reconciler results: allocated=420, holds=po-9981 (provisional), available=92 -> vendor now matches our metrics.

kevin: awesome. I'll update the demo booking doc and CC finance so invoice doesn't auto-pay. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maria: FYI I added a quick alert rule: if vendor-allocated - our-active > 20 for > 10m trigger a Slack ping to #eng-infra and ops-oncall. Should reduce surprises.

kevin: perfect. closing out.
